name: bld6_tsum_inv_fib_mul_fib_add_two
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_tsum_inv_three_consecutive_aux1 (general telescoping HasSum lemma): take g n = 1/(F_(n+1) F_(n+2)); then g n - g (n+1) = (F_(n+3) - F_(n+1))/(F_(n+1)F_(n+2)F_(n+3)) = 1/(F_(n+1)F_(n+3)) by Nat.fib_add_two, g → 0 since F_(n+1) ≥ n/…→∞ (Nat.fib_lt_fib_succ / le_fib_self), and g 0 = 1.
